integrity: The proof reduces the subset hypothesis to the all-periodic-orbit hypothesis using Livsic theory, specification, and periodic-orbit entropy counting, then applies the published surface rigidity theorem. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to closed connected C-infinity surfaces of strictly negative curvature. The exceptional periodic-orbit count must have zero exponential growth rate. No result is proved for positive-exponential exceptional sets, finite-volume noncompact surfaces, or higher dimensions.
title: Subexponential exceptional sets still force constant curvature in surface geodesic flows
